finding: Admin tab navigation broken on mobile — sidebar uses hidden md:block
evidence: Tab interface has left nav with md:block class; no tab selector appears below 768px
user_impact: Admins on phones cannot switch between admin tabs
business_impact: Blocks mobile admin adoption for 30%+ mobile-first users
recommended_fix: Add <select> dropdown or horizontal scroll tabs when sidebar is hidden

finding: Missing aria-activedescendant on autocomplete input
evidence: Input has aria-autocomplete=list but no aria-activedescendant when arrow-nav through results
user_impact: Screen reader users cannot follow which option is highlighted in autocomplete
business_impact: Excludes blind users from primary search workflow
recommended_fix: Add aria-activedescendant pointing to highlighted option's id on keyboard nav

finding: Formatting toolbar buttons are 28px — fail 44px WCAG 2.5.8 touch target minimum
evidence: Buttons use h-7 w-7 (28px); no mobile media query override
user_impact: Users with motor impairments struggle to tap correct button on mobile
business_impact: Poor mobile composer UX drives users to other platforms
recommended_fix: Increase to min-h-9 (36px) on desktop, min-h-11 (44px) on mobile via media query

finding: 150+ hardcoded user-facing strings — zero i18n usage
evidence: No t() calls in entire 1647-line file; all labels/headings/buttons hardcoded
user_impact: International admins cannot use admin panel
business_impact: Blocks enterprise adoption in non-English markets
recommended_fix: Migrate all strings to t() with admin.* keys in en.json

finding: 80+ hardcoded user-facing strings — zero i18n usage
evidence: No t() calls; all section headings, labels, buttons hardcoded
user_impact: International users cannot adjust preferences
recommended_fix: Migrate to t() with settings.* keys in en.json

finding: 50+ hardcoded strings — zero i18n usage
evidence: No t() calls; all operator hints, placeholders, labels hardcoded
user_impact: International users cannot use search operators or understand labels
business_impact: Primary workflow blocked for non-English users
recommended_fix: Migrate to t() using existing search.* keys in en.json

finding: Reset/Delete confirmation dialogs lack focus traps
evidence: Dialogs render as fixed overlays without focus cycling; Tab can reach behind backdrop
user_impact: Users can accidentally interact with content behind confirmation dialog
business_impact: Confusion during destructive actions, potential data loss
recommended_fix: Add full focus trap cycling between first and last focusable elements

finding: API failures silently caught with empty arrays
evidence: catch at members/messages fetcher returns {messages:[],members:[]}
user_impact: Users see empty state instead of error message — no retry option
business_impact: Trust erosion when data silently disappears
recommended_fix: Add error state with retry button when API calls fail

finding: Dual save mechanism — auto-save AND Save Preferences button
evidence: handleNotificationChange() calls savePreferences() immediately; separate Save button also present
user_impact: Users confused about which save method to use
recommended_fix: Choose auto-save paradigm — remove explicit Save button, add debounce on auto-save

finding: Language change triggers window.location.reload()
evidence: line 412: window.location.reload() after locale change
user_impact: Transient state lost on language switch — jarring experience
recommended_fix: Use router.refresh() or locale context update instead of full reload

finding: No result count shown in search results
evidence: Search results display items and Show more button but never total count
user_impact: Users have no sense of results scope or completeness
business_impact: Reduced search utility, users may miss information
recommended_fix: Add Showing {count} of {total} results text

finding: Type dropdown and autocomplete lack role=listbox
evidence: Popover with buttons (type menu) and autocomplete items have no listbox role
user_impact: Screen readers don't recognize interactive lists
business_impact: Reduced accessibility for primary search workflow
recommended_fix: Add role=listbox to containers, role=option to items

finding: Results container has no role=listbox or aria-live=polite
evidence: Search results rendered as <Link> children of <div> without roles
user_impact: Screen readers don't announce new search results
recommended_fix: Add role=listbox, aria-live=polite, role=option on items

finding: No arrow-key navigation between toolbar buttons
evidence: All 15 buttons only navigable via Tab — no Left/Right arrow support
user_impact: Power users must Tab through all 15 buttons to reach target
recommended_fix: Implement WAI-ARIA toolbar pattern with Left/Right arrow key navigation

finding: No visible focus ring on toolbar buttons
evidence: transition-colors present but no focus-visible:ring or outline
user_impact: Keyboard users cannot see which button has focus
recommended_fix: Add focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[var(--button-bg)]

finding: Link/image buttons have aria-pressed: undefined
evidence: Ternary in isActive check returns undefined for non-toggle buttons
user_impact: Screen readers get confused by undefined aria-pressed
recommended_fix: Use aria-haspopup=dialog for link/image buttons instead of aria-pressed

finding: 20+ hardcoded strings — no i18n
evidence: All tooltips, labels, URL form text hardcoded
user_impact: International users see English-only toolbar
recommended_fix: Migrate to t() with formatting.* keys

finding: 20+ hardcoded strings — no i18n
evidence: All labels, radio options, button text hardcoded
user_impact: International users can't understand notification settings
recommended_fix: Migrate to t() with notifications.* keys

finding: 25+ hardcoded strings — no i18n
evidence: All categories, shortcut labels, search placeholder hardcoded
user_impact: International users see English-only shortcut reference
recommended_fix: Migrate to t() using existing keyboardShortcuts.* keys in en.json

finding: No Mac modifier detection — shows Ctrl+K on Mac
evidence: All shortcuts hardcoded as Ctrl+ regardless of platform
user_impact: Mac users see wrong modifier keys
recommended_fix: Detect navigator.platform and swap Ctrl→⌘, Alt→⌥

finding: No aria-live on filtered results
evidence: No live region announces how many shortcuts match search
user_impact: Screen readers don't know results changed after filter
business_impact: Reduced accessibility of search within shortcuts
recommended_fix: Add aria-live=polite for count announcement

finding: Error states lack role=alert
evidence: No role=alert or aria-live on error containers
user_impact: Screen readers don't announce errors
business_impact: Reduced error accessibility for blind users
recommended_fix: Add role=alert + aria-live=assertive to all error state containers

finding: Loading states lack aria-busy=true — no role=status
evidence: No aria-busy on skeleton/spinner containers
user_impact: Screen readers can't distinguish loading from finished
business_impact: Reduced perceived performance for assistive tech users
recommended_fix: Add aria-busy=true + role=status to all loading containers

finding: Bare spinner instead of layout-aware skeleton
evidence: Just a circular spinner — no page structure
user_impact: Users see empty animation with no context about what's loading
business_impact: Poor perceived performance on initial load
recommended_fix: Replace with lightweight skeleton matching page layout structure

finding: Sidebar skeleton shown unconditionally on mobile
evidence: Loading layout includes w-60 sidebar that appears on all screens
user_impact: Mobile users see desktop sidebar briefly before layout renders
recommended_fix: Add hidden md:flex to sidebar skeleton on mobile

finding: No role=dialog, no focus trap, no progressbar role
evidence: Root div has no role; progress div has no ARIA; Tab can escape
user_impact: Screen readers don't recognize onboarding as a distinct region
recommended_fix: Add role=dialog + aria-modal=true + focus trap + role=progressbar

finding: No focus trap, no aria-modal=true
evidence: Tab can cycle behind banner; no aria-modal
user_impact: Users can accidentally interact with content behind banner
recommended_fix: Add focus trap + aria-modal=true

finding: Tab bar missing role=tablist, aria-selected
evidence: Tab buttons are plain buttons without tab semantics
user_impact: Screen readers don't recognize tab navigation pattern
recommended_fix: Add role=tablist, role=tab, aria-selected to tab pattern

finding: Empty states lack actionable buttons
evidence: No members yet but no Invite Members button; no pinned messages but no guidance
user_impact: Users don't know how to populate empty sections
recommended_fix: Add Invite members button to empty members; add Pin a message hint for empty pins

finding: highlightText function duplicated in 2 files with different styling
evidence: Two identical functions: one with yellow bg, one with CSS var bg
user_impact: Inconsistent search highlighting across surfaces
business_impact: Visual inconsistency erodes design system trust
recommended_fix: Extract highlightText to shared utility with configurable class

finding: Pagination UI duplicated across 3 admin tabs
evidence: Identical Previous/Page X of Y/Next code in renderUsers, renderChannels, renderAuditLog
user_impact: Code duplication increases maintenance burden
business_impact: Technical debt slows future admin changes
recommended_fix: Extract shared Pagination component

finding: Stat grid uses grid-cols-2 on mobile — very narrow cells
evidence: Stat cards in overview tab forced into 2-column on <640px
user_impact: Metrics unreadable on small screens
recommended_fix: Use grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2

finding: 30-frame requestAnimationFrame loop for initial scroll
evidence: useEffect with 30-frame rAF counter before scrollToIndex
user_impact: Potential jank on low-end devices during initial load
business_impact: Reduced perceived performance on older devices
recommended_fix: Replace with single scrollToIndex with align:end after measurement effect settles

finding: Two parallel CSS variable systems — Mattermost vars and design token vars
evidence: Both --button-bg (Mattermost) and --color-button-primary-bg (design token) actively used
user_impact: Confusion about which variables to use — inconsistency risk
recommended_fix: Document both layers, migrate toward single convention over time

finding: console.warn used instead of user-facing toast in 5+ catch blocks
evidence: catch blocks in chat-view, context-menu, quick-switcher, thread-panel use console.warn
user_impact: Users unaware of background failures
recommended_fix: Replace console.warn with toast.error() or appropriate user feedback

finding: Dark mode --text-secondary hardcoded rgba instead of using alpha variable
evidence: html.dark definition: --text-secondary: rgba(255,255,255,0.64) instead of deriving from --text-secondary-alpha
user_impact: Theme token system inconsistency — harder to maintain theming
recommended_fix: Derive dark mode --text-secondary from --text-secondary-alpha token

finding: Loading... text instead of Skeleton component
evidence: Raw Loading... string in trigger words section
user_impact: Minor visual inconsistency
recommended_fix: Replace with <Skeleton />

finding: Auto-responder textarea lacks character counter
evidence: maxLength=500 set but no indicator of remaining chars
user_impact: Users don't know how long their message is
recommended_fix: Add 42/500 character counter

finding: No debounce on preference saves — rapid toggles hammer API
evidence: Each toggle change immediately calls savePreferences()
user_impact: Rapid clicking could trigger multiple API calls
business_impact: Minor performance concern on slow networks
recommended_fix: Add 300ms debounce on preference saves

finding: No password strength indicator on sign-up
evidence: No min length/complexity requirements shown to user
user_impact: Users may create weak passwords
recommended_fix: Show password requirements (min 8 chars, etc.) in sign-up mode

finding: No Forgot password? link
evidence: No password reset flow accessible from the form
user_impact: Users who forget password have no recovery path from login page
recommended_fix: Add Forgot password? link that triggers password reset flow

finding: No aria-live on status container
evidence: Status changes (sent/signedup) rendered without live region
user_impact: Screen readers don't announce auth status changes
recommended_fix: Add aria-live=polite aria-atomic=true to status container

finding: No unsaved-changes detection on Escape
evidence: Changes lost silently when user presses Escape or clicks outside
user_impact: Users may accidentally lose preference changes
recommended_fix: Add unsaved-changes warning before closing if state differs

finding: No validation that dateFrom <= dateTo
evidence: Both date fields accept independently — no range validation
user_impact: Users can submit impossible date ranges
recommended_fix: Disable search or show warning when dateFrom > dateTo

finding: Hardcoded year 2025 in operator hint
evidence: Operator hint example: on:2025-01-15
user_impact: Example shows stale year
recommended_fix: Use new Date().getFullYear() for dynamic year

finding: Clear all recent searches has no confirmation
evidence: One click destroys all history with no undo
user_impact: Users may accidentally clear search history
recommended_fix: Add Are you sure? confirmation before clearing recent searches

finding: Export buttons lack loading spinner
evidence: downloadExport() fires without disabled state or spinner
user_impact: Users see no feedback during export fetch
recommended_fix: Add disabled state + spinner during export fetch

finding: No error boundary per tab
evidence: If one tab's API call throws, entire admin panel errors
user_impact: Isolated tab failure breaks whole page
recommended_fix: Wrap each tab content in React error boundary

finding: document.title hardcoded
evidence: document.title = Admin - Chat
user_impact: Title not localized
recommended_fix: Use t() for page title

finding: Inline StatusBadge and Card components
evidence: Helper components defined locally instead of imported from @chat/ui
user_impact: Duplicated component implementations
recommended_fix: Replace with shared StatusBadge from @chat/ui

finding: ToggleRow inline component not shared
evidence: 896-936 lines: inline ToggleRow could be reusable
user_impact: Duplicated pattern if used elsewhere
recommended_fix: Extract ToggleRow to shared component

finding: CSV parser uses line.split(,) — breaks on quoted fields
evidence: line.split(,) on line 252 — no handling for commas in data

recommended_fix: Use proper CSV parser library or write quote-aware parser

finding: 30-frame RAF loop in useEffect for scroll
evidence: requestAnimationFrame loop counts to 30 before scrolling
user_impact: Wasteful pattern — measurements settle faster
recommended_fix: Replace with single scrollToIndex call after useEffect measurement

finding: Inline styles on pull-to-refresh indicator
evidence: Pull to refresh indicator uses inline style instead of Tailwind utility
user_impact: Style inconsistency
recommended_fix: Convert to Tailwind utility classes

finding: Dead CSS property: gridArea: team-sidebar
evidence: gridArea: team-sidebar set but parent uses flexbox not CSS grid
user_impact: Dead code adds confusion
recommended_fix: Remove dead CSS property

finding: --border-default includes solid 1px — not composable
evidence: --border-default: solid 1px var(--border-default-color) prevents using border-top
user_impact: Cannot use border-top with the default variable
recommended_fix: Split into --border-width-default, --border-style-default, --border-color-default

finding: Density modes (comfortable/compact/spacious) defined but unused
evidence: Three density modes in spacing.ts but no implementation
user_impact: Users have no density controls despite tokens existing
